name: Suddha Brahma Paratpara Rama
text:
शुद्धब्रह्म परात्पर राम
कालात्मक परमेश्वर राम
शेषतल्पसुखनिद्रित राम
ब्रह्माद्यमरप्रार्थित राम ॥
meaning: Rama is the pure supreme reality, the essence of time, the ultimate Lord, resting on the serpent Adishesha, worshipped by Brahma and the other celestial beings.
purpose: Praise of Rama as supreme reality.
when: As a chant, at any pace.
